messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.5.8

1.5.8. Noise Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way that risks resulting from the emission of airborne noise are reduced to the lowest level, taking account of technical progress and the availability of means of reducing noise, in particular at source. The level of noise emission may be assessed with reference to comparative emission data for similar machinery or related products.

response.text:
Machinery or related products | shallBeDesignedAndConstructed | in such a way that risks from airborne noise emission are reduced to the lowest level | "" | "Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way that risks resulting from the emission of airborne noise are reduced to the lowest level"
Noise risk reduction | takesAccountOf | technical progress and the availability of means of reducing noise | "" | "taking account of technical progress and the availability of means of reducing noise"
Noise reduction | prioritizes | reduction at source | "" | "in particular at source"
Noise emission level | mayBeAssessedBy | comparative emission data for similar machinery or related products | "" | "The level of noise emission may be assessed with reference to comparative emission data for similar machinery or related products"
